applicable_failures: Folder count mismatch: the stated goal was one line for each of 306 matter folders, but the scan produced 266 lines, and the agent called 266 'matching the 266 matter folders'. The find output for folders was never shown in a way that confirms this, and the goal itself said 306. The 40-matter gap was never explained.
Batches were hard-coded as seq 1001..1046 (matter prefixes), so any folder outside that range would be skipped. The 266 total was never checked against a real folder count.

Candidates were narrowed by filters: addback>=1 from the scan, then a filename grep for 'execution|executed|agreement.docx|facility'. This dropped matters whose signed documents are named differently, and the 14-matter candidate list in the summary is not the full addback>=1 set.
Zero-file matters (1042-00005 and 1044-00001 show files=0 but non-zero sponsor/strategic counts) suggest the scan did not read some folders properly, and this was never checked.
critique.concerns: The agent claims full coverage but the goal said 306 folders and it got 266. The 40-matter discrepancy is unexplained. Some rows show files=0, so extraction may have failed for them. The candidate list was then built from keyword counts plus a filename filter, which will miss signed deals.
critique.recommendation: Reconcile 306 against 266 by listing every folder and diffing it against the scan output. Rerun any missing folders, and any with files=0, using a folder-driven loop rather than a numeric range. Keep the full per-matter table as the candidate base, and don't narrow it by filename or add-back counts until each Banking & Finance matter has been opened.
